questions.hypothesis:
Based on your confirmed adoption of APA 7th edition and your standing instructions, you should list your sources as follows:

### Reference List
*   **General Format**: Alphabetize all entries by the author's last name and use hanging indents for each entry.
*   **Books**: Use the format: Last, F. M. (Year). *Title of book*. Publisher.

### In-Text Citations
*   **Basic Format**: (Author, Year)
*   **Two Authors**: (Smith & Johnson, 2020)
*   **Three or More Authors**: (Smith et al., 2020)
*   **Direct Quotations**: Include the page number, e.g., (Smith, 2020, p. 123)
*   **No Author**: Use the title of the work in place of the author, e.g., ("Title of Work," 2020)

questions.hypothesis:
Your essay performance goals and feedback have evolved from a focus on basic grade improvement to achieving high academic standards and professional publication.

**Evolution of Goals and Feedback**
*   **Initial Grade Concerns:** You began with the goal of raising your essay grade from a B- to an A by June 15, 2024. Your initial progress was marked by an 82% rating from Michele on your essay outline, and you set a target of 90% for your first draft.
*   **Grading Achievement:** You successfully met your target, receiving a 90% grade on your final essay.
*   **Transition to Publication:** Following a recommendation from Robert, your goal shifted toward academic publishing. This has led you to restructure your paper for a journal format, which includes adding a 500-word literature review section.

**Key Improvements to Prioritize**
To meet both your grading and publication targets, you must prioritize the following improvements based on feedback from your mentors and peers:

*   **Argumentation and Evidence:**
    *   **Stronger Warrants:** Implement Robert's recommendation to use stronger warrants for claims regarding gender bias to make your arguments more persuasive.
    *   **Statistical Evidence:** Incorporate more statistical evidence as suggested by Heather.
    *   **Counterarguments:** Integrate counterarguments from feminist critiques, as advised by Michele, to make your work more robust.
*   **Structure and Clarity:**
    *   **Thesis and Flow:** Continue refining your thesis statement for clarity and specificity, and improve the essay's flow using transition phrases.
    *   **Journal Formatting:** Prioritize the restructuring of the paper into a journal format and the effective integration of the new 500-word literature review section.
